note: Explorer toolbar strips in browseui.dll: RT_BITMAP, 32 bits per pixel with straight alpha, square cells (the strip's height) loaded as image lists by dll/win32/browseui/toolsband.cpp. Which cells are replaced comes from Afterglow's map.json (every cell it verifies for browseui.dll); `cells` adds only cells the map does not name. A cell is replaced in place, so the strip keeps its id, size and depth. Cell indexes are the *ImageIndex constants in toolsband.cpp.
